verification_note: This file records what WRAYVE BELIEVES the HeyGen contract to be. It has not been confirmed against a live HeyGen account from this environment. The adapter performs a live preflight before every real execution and refuses to proceed if the contract cannot be confirmed. WRAYVE never substitutes assumed behaviour for observed behaviour.

credentials.name: HEYGEN_API_KEY
credentials.storage: server-side environment variable only; never sent to the browser

endpoints.purpose: Confirm credentials are valid and the account exposes the avatar catalogue the compile step depends on.
Poll job state and retrieve the output URL.

unmapped_scene_fields_note: WRAYVE holds these as creative intent. The declared HeyGen avatar-video contract exposes no confirmed parameter for them, so the adapter refuses to silently drop or re-interpret them: it records them as carried-but-unexecuted direction on the GenerationEvent.
required_provider_binding_note: An avatar_id/voice_id is a HeyGen-side identity artefact. WRAYVE will not invent one. Until an operator records a verified binding in SETTINGS, real HeyGen execution is refused at the adapter boundary.
